moment.title: TI-84 Evo graphing calculator at national retail
moment.summary: The TI-84 Evo was released on April 28, 2026 in the United States, replacing the TI-84 CE Python, at a $160 retail price with a four-year online emulator license included. Amazon cut its price for back-to-school and again during its Labor Day sale, and TI is promoting it to classrooms with a bundle of 10 handhelds plus 50 online licenses.

moment.title: TI calculator packaging moves from blister packs to folding cartons
moment.summary: A TI distributor reported in February 2025 that TI calculators are moving from blister packs to folding cartons as a running change, so some models may already be in the new packaging while others remain in older packaging.

evidence.exact_quote: You will now be seeing less and less of the blister packs, and more of the... drum roll... folding cartons!
The packaging transition is a running change.
You may see some models already in the new packaging while other models remain in older packaging.

opportunities.why_flowcode_fits: TI is moving its whole calculator line onto new folding cartons as a running change, so packaging artwork is already being reprinted model by model. Adding a code to the new cartons now, with the link set after printing, costs little and gives each model a sign-up and support entry point.
opportunities.suggested_first_pitch: While the calculator line is already moving to new cartons, add one dynamic code per model; you can point it at tutorials, test-approval info or registration later without reprinting.
